title: Red Hat Security Advisory: gnome-remote-desktop security update
description: Two security vulnerabilities were identified in GNOME Remote Desktop, a remote desktop and screen sharing service for the GNOME desktop environment. The first vulnerability (CVE-2026-96541) involves unauthenticated RDP sockets lacking a handshake deadline. The second vulnerability (CVE-2026-109832) is a busy-wait denial-of-service (DoS) condition in VNC TLS I/O handlers due to GNUTLS error handling. Red Hat has issued an important security update for these issues affecting Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support and related variants.
